title: Impact of Emissions Standard Announcement on Auto Maker Stock Returns

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
We will use an Event Study approach to analyze the impact of the emissions standard announcement on the stock returns of the auto maker, CAR. This method is suitable because it allows us to examine the abnormal returns around the event day, which is the announcement of the new emissions standard. The key assumption is that the stock returns are not affected by other confounding events during the estimation window.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load required libraries
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)

# Read the data
data <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s65_data.csv")

# Create a binary variable for the event window
data$event_window <- ifelse(data$event_day >= -5 & data$event_day <= 5, 1, 0)

# Estimate the model for the estimation window (-10 to -6 and 6 to 10)
estimation_window <- data[data$event_day < -5 | data$event_day > 5, ]
model_est <- lm(ret ~ mkt_ret + beta + event_window, data = estimation_window)

# Estimate the model for the event window (-5 to 5)
event_window_data <- data[data$event_day >= -5 & data$event_day <= 5, ]
model_event <- lm(ret ~ mkt_ret + beta + event_window, data = event_window_data)

# Calculate the abnormal returns (AR)
ar <- coef(model_event)["event_window"] - coef(model_est)["event_window"]

# Print the abnormal return
cat("Abnormal Return (AR):", ar, "\n")

# Robustness check: Cluster-robust standard errors
# Calculate the residuals
residuals <- residuals(model_event)

# Calculate the cluster-robust standard errors
se <- sqrt(covHC(residuals, method = "HC1"))

# Calculate the t-statistic
t_stat <- ar / se

# Print the t-statistic
cat("t-statistic:", t_stat, "\n")
```

## 3. Expected Findings
We expect the abnormal return (AR) to be positive, as the announcement of a new emissions standard may lead to increased demand for cleaner vehicles, which could benefit the auto maker, CAR. The magnitude of the AR is difficult to predict without more information about the specific emissions standard and the market's reaction to it. However, we expect the AR to be significant, indicating a substantial impact on the stock returns of CAR.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Analyze stock returns before and after the announcement to isolate the impact of the emissions standard announcement.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: The announcement of the new emissions standard positively affects CAR's stock returns.
